sections.section_title: MCE cipher context z nonce register 1 (MCE_CCzNR1)
sections.text_helper: Section 51.6.14 "MCE cipher context z nonce register 1 (MCE_CCzNR1)" in chapter 51 (Memory cipher engine (MCE)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2447.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x248 + 0x30 *(z - 1) (z = 1 to 2)
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Writes are ignored if CCLOCK is set in MCE_CCzCFGR register, or GLOCK bit is set in
MCE_CR register.
Bits 31:0 SCNONCE[63:32]: Stream cipher nonce, bits [63:32]
Refer to the MCE_CCzNR0 register for description of the SCNONCE[63:0] bitfield.
